properties.name: Emirate of Córdoba
properties.linkNote: The Codex has no article for the Emirate of Córdoba (756–929). This links to al-Andalus, the region. The Caliphate of Córdoba is a later state (929–1031) and is deliberately NOT linked here.

properties.name: Bulgars
properties.gapNote: Old Great Bulgaria, which is not the First Bulgarian Empire the Codex covers. Deliberately unlinked.

properties.name: Khazars
properties.gapNote: No article for the Khazar Khaganate.

properties.name: Papal States
properties.linkNote: The Papacy is an institution in the Codex, not a territory. The polygon is the temporal state it governed.
